posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina Kaif is reportedly eyeing a big-screen comeback with Chandni Bar 2 after her maternity break, and recently shared a glimpse of life with baby Vihaan.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit Dosanjh leads Imtiaz Ali's Main Vaapas Aaunga, released June 12 with an A.R. Rahman score, even as his global AURA World Tour rolls on.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia Bhatt's Alpha teaser from the YRF Spy Universe set the internet ablaze, and she has Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Love & War lined up next.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka Chopra ranked #3 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities 2026 and is currently shooting SS Rajamouli's epic Varanasi.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: Shah Rukh Khan's King, directed by Siddharth Anand and co-starring daughter Suhana and Deepika Padukone, is locked for a December 2026 release.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena Kapoor Khan has wrapped Meghna Gulzar's Daayra and is reportedly in talks for a Raj & DK project, keeping her slate packed.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha Kapoor's next, Eetha, has locked an August 28 release. She recently lit up Instagram grooving to Michael Jackson's 'Bad'.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika Padukone, expecting her second child, has wrapped her King schedule with Shah Rukh Khan and joins Allu Arjun's Atlee film Raaka.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar franchise has roared past ₹1300 Cr, and the blockbuster is now heading to Japan for a July theatrical run.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya Rai turned heads at Cannes 2026, walking the red carpet in blush-pink couture alongside daughter Aaradhya.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika Mandanna's Cocktail 2 trailer is out ahead of its June 19 release, while she shoots an intense action avatar for Mysaa.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha Ruth Prabhu turns fierce action hero and producer with Maa Inti Bangaaram, a rural family drama hitting theatres June 19.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun kicked off filming on Raaka (AA22xA6) with director Atlee on June 12 — a ₹600 Cr+ sci-fi spectacle co-starring Deepika Padukone.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's Peddi has stormed past ₹200 Cr in India and $3M in North America, becoming his biggest solo-led hit yet.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's Dragon with Prashanth Neel has been pushed to late 2026 as he sports a lean new look, with Anil Kapoor rumored to join as the villain.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi Kapoor co-stars in Ram Charan's blockbuster Peddi and has now been announced opposite Sidharth Malhotra in Maddock's Param Sundari.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya Panday earned praise for her 'most mature' turn in the Dharma romance Chand Mera Dil and has shifted focus to Call Me Bae 2.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara Advani is gearing up for the big-budget Toxic with Yash and the YRF Spy Universe's War 2, while sharing candid moments from new motherhood.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik Roshan signed with Hollywood's Anonymous Content for global representation as Krrish 4 — his directorial debut — gears up to roll this summer.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun Dhawan teams up with father David Dhawan for the comedy Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai, and reunites with Janhvi Kapoor for Sunny Sanskari Ki Tulsi Kumari.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal's The Unstoppable Tour sweeps across the US, Canada and UK this fall, with stops from Boston and Toronto to Oakland and Los Angeles.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: A.R. Rahman scored both Peddi and Main Vaapas Aaunga, premiered his Sufi composition Rangreza at Royal Albert Hall, and plays Houston Symphony in July.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Fresh off a blockbuster political debut with TVK's 108-seat win, Thalapathy Vijay's swan-song film Jana Nayagan is set to become a cultural event.
